name: manual_9cefe8
claim: For StateTransitionManager reorder buffers, a buffered observation that expires before its sequence gap fills must be rejected as stale without advancing the applied watermark; advancing the watermark lets later successors skip a sequence that was never accepted and breaks stale-gap CI coverage.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14 PR213 CI: lint-and-test failed because stale buffered sequence 3 advanced last_applied_key past sequence 2; restoring no-watermark-advance made TestReorderBuffer green and PR213 CI pass.

rationale: 2026-07-14 PR213 CI: lint-and-test failed because stale buffered sequence 3 advanced last_applied_key past sequence 2; restoring no-watermark-advance made TestReorderBuffer green and PR213 CI pass.
